model.title: Association of the overseas countries and territories with the EU including EU/Greenland/Denmark relations

summary.text: This proposal aims to establish or adjust the framework for how overseas territories associated with European countries would relate to the EU. It also seeks to address the specific relationship between the EU and Greenland, including Denmark's role in those relations.
